title: Polyomino Placement: grid territory game
description: The game commonly known by a trademarked name. Players take turns placing polyomino pieces (shapes made of connected squares) onto a 20x20 grid. Each new piece must touch your existing pieces at corners only — never edge-to-edge. Validates: square grid placement, multi-cell spans with arbitrary shapes (not just linear spans like Naval Battle), corner-only adjacency constraint as CEL/placement rule, 2-4 players with starting corners. Pieces are all distinct polyominoes from monominoes through pentominoes (21 shapes, 1+1+2+5+12). Exercises the span system with 2D shapes rather than 1D lines.
close_reason: Polyomino Placement fully playable. 20x20 grid, 21 shapes with rotation/flip, corner-only adjacency, 2/4 players, scoring. 51 tests.
